title: MIF token claims (v0, private-mesh profile)
description: Claims an application can rely on in ID and access tokens issued by a MIF node running the private-mesh profile. Standard OIDC claims not listed here may also be present.

iss.description: The MIF node. Applications trust this issuer and no upstream provider directly.

sub.description: Stable subject identifier at the MIF node, the same in normal and continuity sessions.

roles.description: Roles as of the last live upstream verification.

mif_idp.description: Alias of the upstream provider that verified this sign-in session live. ABSENT for a continuity session (passkey plus identity snapshot). Applications must treat a missing or empty value as continuity and restrict high-risk operations: the check fails closed.
